templates.name: Town & city temptations
templates.description: Small moments in streets and markets that test a character: a thief, a find, a stranger in need.

spec.theme: petty crime, honest or greedy choices, small kindnesses
spec.instructions: One moment, one choice. Start in the middle of it ("A hand brushes your belt"). The greedy choice pays a little more now; the honest one earns a friend or a favour. A chase or a quick grab gets a timer of 15 to 30 seconds.
spec.consequences: Every choice that matters gets a dmnote: who saw it and who might remember.

templates.name: Wilderness hazards & finds
templates.description: Things that happen on the road and in the wild: a rotten bridge, a strange plant, an abandoned camp.

spec.theme: hazards, finds and signs of others on the road
spec.instructions: A hazard gets a skill check with a DC range and a small cost on a failure (a few coins lost, an hour lost, a minor wound in a dmnote). A find gets a simple item with a note on what it is worth.
spec.tone: Vivid, one or two sentences a step.
spec.consequences: Wounds, lost time and conditions go in a dmnote so the DM applies them.

templates.name: Underground moments
templates.description: Caves, dungeons and ruins: traps, echoes, odd things in the dark.

spec.theme: traps, eerie signs and small treasures
spec.instructions: Keep it tense. A trap is a save or check with a timer; a strange sign is a clue the DM explains later (put the real meaning in a dmnote, never in what the player reads).
spec.consequences: Damage and clues go in a dmnote.

templates.name: Tavern trouble
templates.description: A spilled drink, a card sharp, a stranger who knows too much.

spec.theme: brawls brewing, gambling, gossip and offers
spec.instructions: Something happens at the bar or a table. Offer a social way out and a physical one. A bet or a game can cost or win a few coins.
spec.consequences: Grudges, debts and rumours learned go in a dmnote.

templates.name: Shore & sea
templates.description: Tides, wrecks and what the sea gives up.

spec.theme: wreckage, tides, smugglers and sea creatures
spec.instructions: The sea is the danger: a rising tide is a timer, a slippery rock a check. Finds are small and salt-worn.
spec.consequences: Lost gear, wet supplies and smugglers seen go in a dmnote.

templates.name: Swamp & bog
templates.description: Sucking mud, will-o-wisps and things that live in still water.

spec.theme: mud, insects, lights in the mist, sickness
spec.instructions: A misstep is a check with a small cost; a light in the mist is a choice to follow or not. Sickness or leeches go in a dmnote.
spec.consequences: Sickness, lost boots and followed lights go in a dmnote.

templates.name: Night streets
templates.description: After dark in a city: watchmen, cutpurses, doors left open.

spec.theme: crime, the watch, secrets glimpsed through windows
spec.instructions: Choices between minding your business and getting involved. Being caught somewhere is a check or a coin to pay.
spec.consequences: Who they helped, crossed or were seen by goes in a dmnote.

templates.name: Shrines & holy places
templates.description: Offerings, omens and quiet roadside gods.

spec.theme: offerings, omens, small blessings and curses
spec.instructions: Taking from a shrine is the greedy choice; leaving something is the kind one. An omen is a line the DM explains later.
spec.consequences: Blessings, curses and omens go in a dmnote for the DM to apply.
